logs-rich-client-filters.ownedBehavior: Logs filters the bounded 2,000-row client response by surface, provider, agent, model, time, speed, status, intercepted helper, and conversation; reset and visible counts remain available.

cursor-account-pool.ownedBehavior: Cursor OAuth pooling is experimental, default-off, enabled-only, requires two accounts, and rolls optimistic state back on persistence errors.

antigravity-failover-only.ownedBehavior: Antigravity conversations remain sticky; account changes occur only after eligible 429 or authentication failures, with no new-session load balancing toggle.

combo-catalog-provenance.ownedBehavior: Combo rows have derived provenance, minimum detected capacity, conservative tied-limiter cap state, and retain max-input and automatic-compaction ceilings.

claude-code-always-sse.ownedBehavior: Claude Code adapter responses retain the always-SSE transport contract.

cursor-composer-fast-false.ownedBehavior: Cursor Composer requests explicitly carry fast=false where required by the Cursor wire contract.

quota-capacity-aggregation.ownedBehavior: Quota and capacity snapshots aggregate without inflating availability or losing limiting-window evidence.

provider-request-pacing.ownedBehavior: Provider request pacing remains enforced across retries and concurrent dispatch.

subscription-credit-accounting.ownedBehavior: Subscription-credit usage is classified and reported without treating it as ordinary API-key spend.

hosted-tool-handling.ownedBehavior: Hosted tools are admitted, normalized, and guarded by provider capability instead of being silently stripped or executed locally.

cursor-schema-contracts.ownedBehavior: Cursor request and response schemas retain accepted field shapes and reject malformed tool payloads.

cursor-replay-remint.ownedBehavior: Cursor continuation replay and credential reminting preserve the conversation and tool-continuation contract.

cursor-affinity-thread-ownership.ownedBehavior: Cursor accounts remain bound to the owning thread and do not leak affinity across conversations.

cursor-runtime-normalization.ownedBehavior: Cursor runtime payloads normalize provider wire values without losing supported fields.

cursor-blob-integrity.ownedBehavior: Cursor replay blobs remain byte- and ownership-safe across persistence and continuation.

subagent-fallback.ownedBehavior: Subagent candidate and role fallback remains synchronous where required and preserves configured ordering.

oauth-snapshot-compatibility.ownedBehavior: OAuth account snapshot aliases and persisted account shapes remain backward compatible.

native-tls.ownedBehavior: Native certificate, key, and public-origin validation; non-loopback authentication; TLS-aware status/liveness probes; and HTTPS fallback remain supported.

provider-validation.ownedBehavior: Provider credentials, WebSocket endpoints, and provider-specific configuration are validated before persistence or use.

atomic-api-key-rotation.ownedBehavior: API-key rotation uses compare-and-swap persistence and concurrent 429 handlers rebase on the latest generation.
